summary: The @gyomu/concept package serves as the architectural foundation for analyzing and documenting TypeScript project structures. It provides high-level abstractions to convert raw codebase data into formal project concepts and automated documentation.
responsibilities: Orchestrate project analysis by resolving module exports and mapping external dependencies.
Define structural models that represent directories and packages as architectural entities.
Automate the generation and lifecycle management of documentation assets.
Support internationalization and localization workflows within generated project documentation.
Validate generated architectural metadata against codebase reality.

capabilities.name: Project Structural Modeling
capabilities.description: Translates raw TypeScript directory and package structures into formal, persistent conceptual metadata.

capabilities.name: Automated Documentation Generation
capabilities.description: Transforms codebase structural data into standardized, localized documentation artifacts such as README files.

capabilities.name: Architectural Insight Synthesis
capabilities.description: Analyzes project dependency graphs and source exports to generate insights into package boundaries and architectural composition.

designDecisions: Utilizes a composable builder pattern to separate the extraction of structural data from the rendering of documentation.
Employs a persistence-first approach for conceptual data, allowing cached architectures to be loaded for incremental analysis.
Integrates closely with @gyomu/ts-analysis to ensure architectural definitions remain aligned with the physical source code.
Leverages the Effect ecosystem for robust handling of side-effect-heavy operations like file I/O and process orchestration.
usageGuidance: Use buildPackageConcept as the entry point when initiating a full architectural sweep of a project.
Invoke generateReadmeFiles when the build context is finalized to ensure documentation reflects the latest structural changes.
Configure project context consistently to allow for accurate dependency resolution across different sub-packages.
Treat the generated concept models as the single source of truth for downstream tools in the Gyomu ecosystem.
